why: Program S4: the scenarios that score an evolved judge prompt. A candidate is reflected from training failures only and accepted only on held-out data, so the two never overlap, and the evolver cannot write this file (harness/src/evolve.cjs EVALUATOR_FILES). Every scenario here is tier 2 and spawns at least one judge; `exercises` names which, and evolve.cjs refuses a target that no training or no held-out scenario spawns.
changed: 2026-10-23, by hand in a reviewed commit (the only way this file changes; never during a generation): quick-mode (planner and executor only, no judge) left training; evidence-loop (tier 0, no model) and uat-diagnose-native (the debugger, not a judge) left held-out; pair-discounts-live (/pan:quick --full: plan-checker and verifier, judged by a hidden acceptance check) joined held-out.
